adjudication_summary: Worker-4/6 re-review closed the framework-test blocker by completing row-level DBAASP source reconciliation and source-reviewed final adjudication. The paper is publication-grade accepted_with_cautions because all obtainable local evidence is captured and residual caveats are explicit.

caution_findings.evidence_context: No linked_sequence_records were present in the packet. Peptide 1018 identity, sequence, and C-terminal amidation were verified from primary XML/PDF sections instead of a separate database sequence row.
The database Staphylococcus aureus SAP 0017 row is accepted as the source Table 1 S. aureus MRSA #SAP0017 row based on matching MIC value and methods strain description.
Local supplementary assets consist of OA-package TIF figures plus HTML/landing pages; no local XLSX/PDF supplement table was available to parse.
Figure-only mechanism and biofilm image/plot quantities are represented as source-located qualitative mechanism evidence, not invented tabular numeric values.

DBAASP uses E. coli O157 and K. pneumoniae ATCC 13883; the primary table has 0157 and ATTC13883/ATTC 13883, while methods identify E. coli O157 and American Type Culture Collection context. These are accepted as source-context label expansions, not hidden conflicts.

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/NXML, PDF text, OA package archive members including supplementary TIF figures, supplementary landing assets, locator index, and linked DBAASP JSONL rows were opened. No local spreadsheet/PDF supplement table exists; figure-only exact values were not fabricated.
